meta.title: Buka Skills
meta.description: Adds a Skills page to the sidebar: Installed lists the skills installed globally for every DSH session, marks the ones the skills library manages, and checks or applies updates through the same library; Saved keeps a personal list of skill sources, probes each listable source as a standard npx repository (only SKILL.md under the root skills/ directory) or unavailable, and expands the usable ones into a cached tree. Any skill or directory can be installed globally, into a worker, or into a registered workspace; install, uninstall and update share one queue, and the workers page can update one worker or every worker in sequence.
